# Test-first: restore producer-review regression suite & icon contract

Author/restore the failing-first tests that pin the restored `needsProducerReview` contract, **before** the implementation children (test-first ordering). These tests drive F2–F6.

## Goal (user story)

As an agent, I want an executable regression suite that defines the restored flag + producer-review icon behaviour, so the restore (F2–F6) is driven by a failing contract and the removal can never silently recur.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Deleted test corpuses restored from `e0f04202^` / `d18ea50d^`: `tests/cli/reviewed.test.ts`, `tests/api-needs-producer-review-filter.test.ts`, the producer sections of `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts`, `tests/unit/icons.test.ts`, `tests/grouping-utility.test.ts`, `tests/migrations.test.ts`, and the flag flow in `tests/cli/interview.test.ts`.
- [ ] New regression test: `getIconPrefixParts` output contains ❌ when `needsProducerReview === true`, ✅ when `false`, and neither when `undefined`; `noIcons` mode returns `[REVIEW]` / `[OK]`.
- [ ] New migration test: the new add-column migration re-adds `needsProducerReview`; the shipped `20261015-drop-…` migration is a metadata-sentinel no-op and never re-drops the column.
- [ ] New `inReviewBucket` test pins 6 buckets with bucket 1 = `needsProducerReview === true`.
- [ ] Tests are authored against the interface documented in this item (function names/signatures), and fail before the implementation children land.

## Key Files

- `tests/cli/reviewed.test.ts`, `tests/api-needs-producer-review-filter.test.ts`
- `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts`, `tests/unit/icons.test.ts`
- `tests/grouping-utility.test.ts`, `tests/migrations.test.ts`, `tests/cli/interview.test.ts`
- `packages/shared/src/icons-legend.test.ts` (legend drift guard)

## Deliverables

Restored + new failing-first test files and a documented interface contract.


---

## Documented interface contract (test-first target signatures)

The RED-pinned specs in this item target the following restored interfaces
(pre-removal signatures at `e0f04202^` / `d18ea50d^`; implementation
children flip `it.fails(` → `it(` as each surface lands):

- **DB / migration:** new migration with id `20261016-restore-needsProducerReview` re-adds the `needsProducerReview` column; the shipped `20261015-drop-needsProducerReview` migration becomes a metadata-sentinel no-op that never re-drops the column.
- **CLI:** `wl reviewed <id>` toggles; `wl reviewed <id> true|false` sets — command registered from `src/commands/reviewed.ts` via `registerReviewed(ctx)`.
- **API:** `GET /items?needsProducerReview=true|false` filters; invalid values → HTTP 400 `{ error: 'Invalid ...' }`.
- **Shared icons (`@worklog/shared/icons`):** `needsProducerReviewIcon(value, opts)` (❌ true / ✅ false / '' undefined; `[REVIEW]`/`[OK]` fallbacks); `getIconPrefix`/`getIconPrefixParts` include the producer column.
- **CLI theme (`src/theme.ts`):** `needsProducerReviewIcon/Label/Fallback` (❌/✅, `[NEEDS_PRODUCER]`/`[PRODUCER_OK]`).
- **Grouping (core + herdr):** `inReviewBucket` 6 buckets with bucket 1 = `needsProducerReview === true`.
- **Interview (`src/commands/interview.ts`):** `buildProducerReviewExplanation(item, opts)` → `Promise<string|null>`, `buildProducerReviewExplanationResult(item, opts)` → `{ text, usedLlm } | null`, `buildExplanationPrompt`, `buildFallbackExplanation`, `renderExplanation(text, maxChars?, maxLines?)`, `PRODUCER_REVIEW_INSTRUCTION`, `MAX_PROMPT_CONTEXT_BYTES`, `MAX_AUDIT_RAW_OUTPUT_BYTES`.

## Test-first flip map (implementation children)

| Test file | RED-pinned scope | Flipped by |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/cli/reviewed.test.ts` | `wl reviewed` toggle/set | F3 CLI/API |
| `tests/api-needs-producer-review-filter.test.ts` | API filter + 400 | F2 flag / F3 CLI/API |
| `tests/unit/icons.test.ts` (+ producer section) | theme icon/label/fallback | F5 theme |
| `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` (+ producer section) | shared icon + prefix column | F4 herdr icons / F2 icon |
| `tests/grouping-utility.test.ts` | 6-bucket `inReviewBucket` | F4 grouping |
| `tests/migrations.test.ts` | restore migration + drop no-op | F2 flag |
| `tests/cli/interview.test.ts` (+ flag flow) | explain/clear flow | F5 interview |
| `packages/shared/src/icons-legend.test.ts` | producer-review legend category | F4 legend |
